content:
# link_contracts

Public agreements connecting two services, including references to their applicable rule article.

Read this collection using `search_records(resource="link_contracts", filters={}, cursor=0, limit=20)` or `get_record(resource="link_contracts", record_id="<returned id>")`.

**Filters: exact equality only.** Operator objects are literal values here; they do not implement in/contains/ranges.

Search returns selected summary fields, so omission from a summary is not proof of absence from the complete record. Read detail before interpreting an optional field. Fields depend on the record type and processing stage; null and absent fields are not zero amounts. Types below describe public record shapes, rather than mandatory properties on every row.

## Explicit identifier relationships

- `primary_case_id` references a `service_cases` record ID when present. See `DB-service_cases`.
- `secondary_case_id` references a `service_cases` record ID when present. See `DB-service_cases`.

Commercial references can require entity, period or issuer matching. An ID relationship does not imply that every related record repeats the same case_id.

## Fields

| Field | Observed public types | Search use | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Top-level filter | Opaque record key used by get_record; obtain it from returned records or explicit references. It is not an amount, date or proof of business identity. |
| `name` | string | Top-level filter | Human-readable name. Names need not be unique; exact filters are case-sensitive. |
| `operator_category` | string | Top-level filter | Operator category: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `operator_id` | string | Top-level filter | Operator id: opaque identifier reference. Its target depends on the containing record/operation; do not infer a collection merely by pluralizing the field name. Explicit joins are listed separately. |
| `primary_case_id` | string | Top-level filter | Record ID in service_cases. Use get_record on that collection; the link does not make other rows implicitly belong to the same object. |
| `primary_case_name` | string | Top-level filter | Primary case name: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `public_rule_document` | string | Top-level filter | Public document ID; pass it directly to read_document. |
| `reference` | string | Top-level filter | Business reference on this object; its uniqueness depends on the issuer, entity and period. |
| `relation` | string | Top-level filter | Relation: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `scope` | string | Top-level filter | Access namespace for the record. It is not a customer name or a universal case_id. |
| `secondary_case_id` | string | Top-level filter | Record ID in service_cases. Use get_record on that collection; the link does not make other rows implicitly belong to the same object. |
| `secondary_case_name` | string | Top-level filter | Secondary case name: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `status` | string | Top-level filter | Current state of this particular object. A proposal or submission state is distinct from a posted payment or completed review. Public values represented here: `ACTIVE`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |


## Record keys and joins

| Intended lookup | Collection | Key |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Read the capital agreement itself | joint_agreements | id; get_record takes that value as record_id |
| Find its funding sources, delivery routes or posted fundings | joint_sources, joint_routes, joint_fundings | agreement_id equals the returned joint_agreements.id |
| Read a service enquiry itself | service_cases | id |
| Find typed records or operation receipts for that enquiry | service_records, service_bookings | case_id equals service_cases.id, where declared for the record type |
| Filter an access namespace | Collections documenting scope | scope; it is neither an agreement ID nor a service case ID |

joint_agreements does not have an agreement_id field. A field ending in _id is only a join when its collection dictionary documents the target. For all get_record calls, use an ID returned by a query or an explicit reference.


## Link conditions

`condition` states the active contract condition in English. `milestone_scope` gives its current-episode scope, request binding, cash currency per case and qualifying event IDs per case. These are public output fields, not nested filter paths. Read the referenced LINK article for milestone definitions.


Payment v8.1 records may publish `process_policy_family`, `process_rule_document`, `process_scope_summary`, and `process_episode`. They identify an applicable policy but intentionally omit the tool names, arguments and exact solution order.
